details.description: Grok 4.5 is SpaceXAI's coding- and agent-focused chat model, released July 16, 2026, which the maker describes as trained alongside Cursor for software-engineering workflows. It accepts text and image input with text-only output over a 500K-token context window, and offers configurable reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh; high by default). xAI's launch post highlights end-to-end application development from a prompt to a working product, multi-sheet spreadsheet modelling with web research, and document and slide generation.
advantages: Scores 83.3% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (xAI's Grok 4.5 launch post).
Scores 64.7% on SWE-bench Pro and 62.0% on DeepSWE 1.0 (xAI's Grok 4.5 launch post).
Scores 39 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking #52 of 211 models tracked (Artificial Analysis).
xAI reports using roughly 4.2 times fewer output tokens than comparable leading models on SWE-bench Pro tasks.
disadvantages: Scores 53% on DeepSWE v1.1 and 29.0% on SWE Marathon, notably lower than its Terminal-Bench 2.1 score (xAI's Grok 4.5 launch post).
Accepts text and image input only, with text-only output; no audio input/output or native image generation.
Marked deprecated on Artificial Analysis as of September 2026, which recommends Grok 4.6 as a newer alternative; xAI's own docs still list Grok 4.5 as an available model with no deprecation notice.
use_cases: End-to-end application development from a prompt to a working product
Complex spreadsheet modelling with multi-sheet formulas

sources.title: Grok 4.5 (high) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis

notes: grok-4.5-latest is an alias that points to grok-4.5 per xAI's docs (docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.5 lists 'grok-4.5-latest' and 'grok-build-latest' as aliases of the same model), so this entry describes the same model as the grok-4.5 target. docs.x.ai and x.ai/news identify the company as 'SpaceXAI' (docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.5 reads "SpaceXAI's intelligent coding model"; the launch post's title tag is 'Introducing Grok 4.5 | SpaceXAI'), so that name was used as maker instead of 'xAI'. No max-output-tokens value distinct from the 500K context window is given on xAI's docs, matching the catalog's facts.
